title: MORADIA DE CHARME COM PROJETO PARA CONDOMÍNIO BO
description:
Num lote com cerca de 810 m2 esta propriedade conta com um projeto para reabilitação e modernização, especialidades aprovadas, incluindo a ampliação da Área Bruta de Construção até 750m2. 

Localizada na prestigiada Avenida da República, em Cascais, esta é uma oportunidade rara de investimento num condomínio boutique privado, pensado para garantir segurança, privacidade

e conforto. 

O Projeto aprovado contempla três unidades independentes: 

- 2 apartamentos duplex T4

- 1 Moradia exclusiva com jardim e piscina privativa 

Com licenciamento aprovado, elimina-se o risco camarário e permite-se o arranque imediato da obra, acelerando o retorno do investimento.

_

Para mais informações, contacte-nos através de e-mail, telefone/WhatsApp ou das nossas plataformas digitais nacionais e internacionais.

A THe1 defende que cada cliente deve ter um representante único e dedicado, garantindo um acompanhamento consistente e transparente ao longo de todo o processo.

Por este motivo, partilhamos a comissão contratada em regime de 50/50 com qualquer consultor ou agência imobiliária detentora de licença AMI válida que represente o comprador final.

Set on a plot of approximately 810 m², this property features an approved architecture Project, which includes specialty engineering plans, for the rehabilitation, modernization and an expansion of the Gross Construction Area up to 750 m².

Located on the prestigious Avenida da República in Cascais, this represents a rare investment opportunity in a private boutique condominium, designed to ensure maximum security, privacy, and comfort.

The approved plans include three independent units:

- 2 T4 Duplex Apartments (four-bedroom)

- 1 Exclusive Villa with a private garden and swimming pool

Investment Highlights:

With the licensing already fully approved, the 'town hall risk' is eliminated, allowing for an immediate start of construction and a faster return on investment.

_

For more information, please contact us via email, phone/WhatsApp, or our national and international digital platforms.

THe1 believes that every client should have a single, dedicated representative, ensuring consistent and transparent support throughout the entire process.

For this reason, we share the agreed commission on a 50/50 basis with any consultant or real estate agency holding a valid AMI license that represents the end buyer.

Prime Real Estate Cascais: Classic Villa with Expansion Project (750 m²) in the 'Golden Triangle'

We present an exceptional investment opportunity in the most coveted location in Cascais. This property combines the charm of classic architecture with the potential to become one of the most modern and luxurious villas in the historic center.

Property Highlights:

Location: Premium: Situated in the prime center, next to the Paula Rego Museum and Marechal Carmona Park.

Approved Project: Licensing for expansion up to 750 m² of construction, integrating a swimming pool, outdoor leisure areas, and optimized parking.

Sun Exposure: South/West orientation, guaranteeing ideal luminosity throughout the year.

Connectivity: 30 minutes from Lisbon and the International Airport, with immediate access to the motorway network.

The Cascais Lifestyle:

Where the charm of a historic fishing village meets international glamour. Within easy reach of:

Leisure: Cascais Marina, Estoril Casino and 5 championship golf courses.

Education: Proximity to top international schools (St. Julians, TASIS, Carlucci).

Nature: Coastal beaches and the Sintra-Cascais Natural Park.

Where time stands still and the future begins.

In the heart of Cascais, 'Prime' locations are no longer created, they are inherited. This is perhaps the last opportunity to shape a property of this size with an already approved project, eliminating waiting and bureaucracy.

Come stroll through the garden, feel the afternoon light and discover the details of the project that will transform this classic villa into a new luxury icon of the town.

Private visits by prior arrangement. Discover today what Cascais will have best to offer tomorrow.
